toefl_min.value: English B/6 minimum. University Admissions (which Chalmers refers to) sets English 6 at TOEFL iBT 90 with 20 in writing (tests up to 20 Jan 2026) or 4.5 on the new scale with no section below 4; IELTS 6.5
toefl_min.quote: The minimum language requirement is English B/6 (in the Swedish upper secondary school). For more information on this, please see information provided by University Admissions in Sweden.

also.quote: For English 6/English Level 2*: Total score of 4.5 (scale 1-6) with no section less than 4 | For English 6/English Level 2*: Score of 20 (scale 0-30) in written test, total score of 90 | For English 6/English Level 2*: an overall score of 6.5 and no section below 5.5

ielts_min.value: IELTS Academic 6.5 overall with no section below 5.5 (English 6 level that Chalmers refers to).
ielts_min.quote: For English 6/English Level 2*: an overall score of 6.5 and no section below 5.5

also.quote: The minimum language requirement is English B/6 (in the Swedish upper secondary school). For more information on this, please see information provided by University Admissions in Sweden.

english_waiver.value: Indian upper-secondary English can meet the requirement: CBSE (2008 onwards) or CISCE Class XII English grades, or an English-medium upper secondary certificate. The India page offers no degree-based route, so otherwise take a test
english_waiver.quote: grades in the subject English language and at least three other subjects with English as the language of instruction | grades in the subject English language stated in Indian School Certificate Class XII (year 12) that are issued by the Council for the Indian School Certificate Examinations (CISCE) | grades in the subject English language stated in Senior School Certificate Examination / Marks Statement cum Certificate that are issued by Central Board of Secondary Education (CBSE) from 2008 and onwards | Previous university studies and English test | You can also demonstrate that you meet the English language requirement through an internationally approved English test.

also.quote: The minimum language requirement is English B/6 (in the Swedish upper secondary school).

notes: Application fee is not stated on the doctoral pages; the physics record's no-fee reading rests on a sentence about programme fees. Doctoral positions are advertised as jobs, each with its own deadline.
